description: Source code for an image extension node in a rich text editor, including node creation, attributes, HTML parsing/rendering, commands, input rules, and keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: ImageNode
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension for handling images with attributes, commands, and rendering logic.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the image node, such as inline, allowBase64, and HTMLAttributes.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Determines if the node is inline based on options.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Returns the group of the node ('inline' or 'block') based on options.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines attributes for the image node, including src, width, height, alignment, hash, filename, mime, size, aspectRatio, and type.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies how to parse HTML elements into this node, supporting base64 images and migration from inline to block.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render the node as HTML, primarily as an element with merged attributes.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom React component view for the image node.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides commands for inserting images, setting alignment, and setting size.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules for automatically converting markdown-like syntax into image nodes.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts for adding images and copying images to clipboard.
